environment.server: Python SimpleHTTP/0.6 on both exact git archives; no content encoding; candidate interaction adds only the verified generated globe.gl runtime dependency

methodology.context: fresh browser process and fresh context for every run; service workers blocked; browser cache disabled

loss_function.interpretation: A zero candidate loss means the weighted above-threshold penalty was eliminated. Division by zero is undefined, so zero loss is never presented as an infinite or 10x ratio.

methodology.transfer_boundary: Network byte sums are lower bounds over requests completed inside the 8.5 s landing-paint window. Incomplete requests remain itemized and these sums are not complete-navigation transfer totals.

first_paint_action_readiness.method: unthrottled same-origin exact candidate archive with the SHA-pinned generated globe.gl dependency materialized; /js/app.js delayed 1500 ms; exact climate runtime delayed 4500 ms

early.status_text: Loading verified country evidence for the Living Globe.

verdict.claim_boundary: The 10x pass applies only to the exact hero LCP asset payload. Local FCP/LCP latency, CLS, TBT, partial transfer, and first-action readiness are reported separately. Public PageSpeed field/lab performance requires post-deploy measurement.
